evals.prompt: I want a self-hosted, private alternative to Google NotebookLM that I run on my own machine and can drive programmatically. How do I stand it up and organize my research into notebooks?
evals.expected_output: Triggers alterlab-open-notebook. Recommends Open Notebook, the self-hosted open-source NotebookLM alternative with a full REST API. Describes Docker Compose deployment (replacing the OPEN_NOTEBOOK_ENCRYPTION_KEY placeholder in the official docker-compose.yml, then docker compose up -d), the UI at localhost:8502 and REST API at localhost:5055, and creating a notebook via POST /api/notebooks.

assertions.value: Mentions self-hosted deployment (Docker Compose / encryption key) and creating a notebook via the REST API.

evals.prompt: I've collected a bunch of arXiv links and PDFs for my tumor mutational burden review. I want to load them all into one workspace and then ask an AI questions that cite the actual sources. What's the workflow?
evals.expected_output: Triggers alterlab-open-notebook. Explains ingesting sources via POST /api/sources (form field type=link for URLs or type=upload for PDFs, embed=true for vector search), then context-aware chat: create a session with /api/chat/sessions, build context from the notebook's sources with /api/chat/context, and send it with the message to /api/chat/execute so answers draw on those sources. May mention search (/api/search with type vector or text).

assertions.value: Describes ingesting sources into a notebook and using context-aware chat (or search) that cites those sources.

evals.prompt: Can I turn my collected research materials into a podcast episode with three different speakers discussing the findings, all generated locally?
evals.expected_output: Triggers alterlab-open-notebook. Explains Open Notebook's multi-speaker podcast generation (1-4 customizable speakers, beyond NotebookLM's 2-speaker limit) via POST /api/podcasts/generate with episode_profile and speaker_profile names plus an episode_name, polling /api/podcasts/jobs/{job_id}, then finding the episode in /api/podcasts/episodes and downloading its audio.

assertions.value: Describes generating a multi-speaker podcast from research materials via the /api/podcasts generate-and-poll workflow.

evals.prompt: I need my document-analysis notebook to stay fully private with no API costs — can I run it against a local Ollama model instead of a cloud provider, and configure that through the API?
evals.expected_output: Triggers alterlab-open-notebook. Confirms Open Notebook supports 18+ AI providers including Ollama for free local inference and full data sovereignty via self-hosting. Describes configuring a provider/credential (POST /api/credentials), discovering and registering models, and that data stays in local Docker volumes.

assertions.value: Confirms local/private inference via Ollama and configuring the provider through credentials/models in the REST API.

evals.prompt: I just need this one PowerPoint deck converted to clean Markdown text so I can paste it into a prompt — nothing fancy, no database or chat, just the file as Markdown.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger alterlab-open-notebook — there's no notebook, ingestion, chat, search, or podcast involved. A one-shot PPTX-to-Markdown conversion is alterlab-markitdown's job (Microsoft MarkItDown CLI/Python). Defer to alterlab-markitdown.

evals.prompt: Organize my Zotero library: move the 60 immunotherapy papers into a new collection, tag the ones missing DOIs, and export the collection as BibTeX.
evals.expected_output: Should NOT trigger alterlab-open-notebook — this is reference-library management in Zotero (collections, tags, BibTeX export via the Zotero Web API), not ingesting sources into a self-hosted notebook for AI chat or podcasts. Defer to alterlab-pyzotero.
